diff --git a/src/slugify.py b/src/slugify.py
index d57c7ba..f23783a 100644
--- a/src/slugify.py
+++ b/src/slugify.py
@@ -13,6 +13,6 @@ def slugify(value: str | None) -> str:
     text = str(value).replace("ß", "ss")
     text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
     text = text.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
-    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", text.lower())
+    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s.-]", "", text.lower())
     text = re.sub(r"[-\s]+", "-", text).strip("-")
     return text
diff --git a/tests/test_slugify.py b/tests/test_slugify.py
index cf37444..e5d593f 100644
--- a/tests/test_slugify.py
+++ b/tests/test_slugify.py
@@ -20,3 +20,7 @@ def test_german_characters():
 def test_empty_and_edge_cases():
     assert slugify("") == ""
     assert slugify(None) == ""
+
+
+def test_dots_are_preserved():
+    assert slugify("api.v1 endpoint") == "api.v1-endpoint"

 M src/slugify.py
 M tests/test_slugify.py
